title: Binding a chat to its lane
summary: A chat is nudged only when it is bound: a line LANE|ADAPTER|CHAT or LANE|PRINCIPAL|ADAPTER|CHAT in etc/nudge.conf or var/nudge.local.conf. CHAT is stored as the conversation path (/c/<id> on chatgpt.com, /chat/<uuid> on claude.ai), which never changes. Tom binds by title (mailnudge.rex bind LANE ADAPTER TITLE WORDS [--as PRINCIPAL]: looked up in the site's sidebar, the path stored), by the address bar (bind LANE https://...), or by path. Lane * binds a chat to every lane not bound by name for that principal (the coordinator). Binding a lane again replaces its line; unbind LANE [PRINCIPAL] removes it; chats ADAPTER [WORDS] lists the sidebar with paths; unbound lists lanes with mail waiting and no chat. A running nudger reads the binding files again whenever they change: no restart.
invariants: A chat cannot see its own address, so it cannot bind itself: ask Tom, giving your lane id and your chat's title.
A title must match one sidebar chat exactly, or be contained in one title only; otherwise the candidates are listed and nothing is bound. A chat too old for the sidebar is bound by address.
Bindings are checked: lane ids, principals, paths of letters, digits, / - _ only, https chatgpt.com or claude.ai addresses only.
The coordinator chat is bound as *|COORDINATOR|chatgpt|/c/6ae3874a-2690-83ed-8d8f-4eccb6bf1e08 (Continue Coordinator Handoff, 15 Nov 2026).
Claude Code cloud sessions (claude.ai/code/...) have no adapter yet and cannot be nudged.
